channel.title: Pakistan Economic Dashboard — Critical series
channel.description: Updates for reserves, inflation, FBR tax, trade, remittances and headline KPIs from official sources.

item.title: Foreign Exchange Reserves: 2026-08-07 (fresh)
item.description: Source: State Bank of Pakistan. Latest observation: 2026-08-07. Coverage: 2025-06 – 2026-08-07. Usually published weekly; dashboard should advance after SBP updates forex.pdf.

item.title: Monthly Average Exchange Rates: 2026-07 (fresh)
item.description: Source: State Bank of Pakistan. Latest observation: 2026-07. Coverage: 2021-01 – 2026-07. Monthly archive usually updates after month-end. Daily/current SBP rates are not used in this monthly chart.

item.title: Workers' Remittances: 2026-06 (fresh)
item.description: Source: SBP EasyData API. Latest observation: 2026-06. Coverage: 2021-08 – 2026-06. Usually published monthly; April data is not expected until SBP releases the next workers remittance update.

item.title: Trade in Goods: 2026-06 (fresh)
item.description: Source: State Bank of Pakistan. Latest observation: 2026-06. Coverage: 2021-01 – 2026-06. Monthly BOP goods trade data.

item.title: Foreign Direct Investment: 2026-06 (fresh)
item.description: Source: State Bank of Pakistan. Latest observation: 2026-06. Coverage: monthly through 2026-06; sector Jul-Jun FY26; country Jul-Jun FY26; headline FY2026 Jul-Jun (Netinflow.xls). Monthly net FDI can lead the detailed sector, country, and FYTD workbooks.

item.title: IT & Services Trade: 2026-06 (fresh)
item.description: Source: State Bank of Pakistan. Latest observation: 2026-06. Coverage: Jul-May FY26. Headline IT and total-services data can lead the detailed EBOPS category and freelance breakdown.

item.title: Inflation: 2026-07 (fresh)
item.description: Source: SBP EasyData API / PBS. Latest observation: 2026-07. Monthly CPI/WPI series sourced through SBP EasyData.

item.title: Monetary Sector: 2026-07 (fresh)
item.description: Source: SBP EasyData API. Latest observation: 2026-07. SBP monetary series include weekly/monthly observations depending on the indicator.

item.title: Public Finance & GDP: FY2026 (fresh)
item.description: Source: SBP EasyData API / SBP GDP table. Latest observation: FY2026. Coverage: FY2017 – FY2026. GDP/fiscal data is lower frequency than external-sector data.

item.title: FBR Tax Collection: 2026-06 (needs-review)
item.description: Source: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR). Latest observation: 2026-06. FBR's official 1 July release confirms target achievement and Rs599bn of refunds but omits the numeric collection total. The Rs13,003bn FY2025-26 net collection is therefore retained as explicitly attributed provisional reporting until FBR publishes its official month-wise/tax-wise table or year book.. FBR publishes provisional monthly net collection in a press release shortly after each month-end; figures are finalised later in the FBR Year Book.

item.title: IMF Program Tracker: 2026-05-08 (fresh)
item.description: Source: IMF / official program documents. Latest observation: 2026-05-08. Update when IMF publishes Board decisions, press releases, staff reports, or official schedule changes.
